newsitem.title: UK: UK minister Willetts replaced by Michael Bates.
newsitem.headline: UK minister Willetts replaced by Michael Bates.

text.p: Conservative member of parliament Michael Bates was on Wednesday named to replace David Willetts, who resigned his ministerial post of Paymaster-General, the government said.

Willetts, one of Prime Minister John Major's top strategists, quit after the release of a report which said he had not been "frank and open" in evidence to a parliamentary committee probing whether MPs took cash to ask questions for businessmen in parliament.
Bates, 35, is currently a government whip (business manager) and represents the constituency of Langbaurgh in northern England.
